from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    s = 0
    for i, x in enumerate(a):
        s += x
        prefix[i + 1] = s

    best_num = prefix[k]
    best_den = k

    hull: list[int] = []
    head = 0

    for j in range(k, n + 1):
        t = j - k
        pt = prefix[t]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            u = hull[-2]
            v = hull[-1]
            if (prefix[v] - prefix[u]) * (t - v) >= (pt - prefix[v]) * (v - u):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(t)

        pj = prefix[j]
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            u = hull[head]
            v = hull[head + 1]
            if (prefix[v] - prefix[u]) * (j - u) <= (pj - prefix[u]) * (v - u):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        u = hull[head]
        num = pj - prefix[u]
        den = j - u
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    g = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // g, best_den // g]
